bio:
Charity Gould was the eldest child of Jacob Gould (d. 1849, aged 77, buried in the old Shupp cemetery, Plymouth; a New Jersey Revolutionary soldier) and Hannah Davenport, daughter of Thomas and Charity (Lamoreux) Davenport ([R4-S1]). She married Benjamin Pringle (1794-1853), son of Samuel and Martha (Lamoreaux) Pringle, about 1821, so she was both a granddaughter of Charity Lamoreux Davenport and a daughter-in-law of Martha Lamoreaux Pringle. Their children were Bethia (m. Caleb Roberts 1852, went to Iowa), Martha Ann (m. William Hutchinson), 'Lege' (Elijah, b. 1825/26, d. 1898, whose will is indexed in Salem Twp. 1898), Ira (1833/35-1918), Jacob Gould, Martin (California), and Caleb (b. 1839, 'went West') ([R4-S1], [R4-S2]).

A primary record now names her as a mother: the 1897 death register of the town of Verona, Faribault Co., Minnesota, records Bethia Roberts, widow, died 30 Dec 1897 aged 75 years 3 months 9 days, born Pennsylvania, of Bright's disease, parents 'Benj. Pringle' and 'Charity Pringle', both born Pennsylvania ([R4-S3]). The FamilySearch tree gives Charity's birth as 16 Feb 1800 in Salem Twp. and her death on 19 Jan 1883 at Lehman, with burial at Beach Grove Cemetery, Beach Haven ([R4-S2]).

conflicts.found: FS L4WX-HKC also attaches Oliver Mekeel (1796-1847) as a spouse and his children (1820-1844), plus a 'Charity Mekeel' cemetery record
conflicts.assessment: FS has merged her with Charity (Pringle) Mekeel (1800-1899), daughter of James Pringle and wife of Oliver Mekeel (Harvey Book p.980). The Mekeel data do not belong to Charity Gould. Her FS death date/burial may also come from the merged profile and should be checked.
